changes.oldText: await run('DESIGN-STANDARD-SPRITES',async()=>{const source=L.read(L.path.join(dir,manifest.candidate)),vm=require('vm'),sandbox={Object,STANDARD_AKARI_MASCOT:{kind:'image'}};const match=source.match(/const STANDARD_SPRITES\s*=\s*Object.freeze\(\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*\);/);assert(match);const registry=vm.runInNewContext('('+match[1]+')',sandbox);const buttons=p.locator('[data-sprite-preset]'),ids=await buttons.evaluateAll(ns=>ns.map(n=>n.dataset.spritePreset));assert.equal(new Set(ids).size,ids.length);assert.deepEqual(ids.slice().sort(),Object.keys(registry).sort());const images=p.locator('[data-sprite-preset] img');assert.equal(await images.count(),Object.values(registry).filter(v=>v.kind==='image').length);await p.waitForFunction(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sprite-preset] img')].every(e=>e.complete&&e.naturalWidth>0&&e.naturalHeight>0));return{count:ids.length,unique:true,allRegistered:true,imagePresetsDecoded:await images.count()};});
changes.preservedMeaning: Explicit user request adds Dango as a second image mascot. CI run 36938045944 fails all six DESIGN-STANDARD-SPRITES tuples because the isolated registry sandbox lacks DANGO_MASCOT_ASSET_ID. Bind that dependency from the product declaration, and retain every original registry/button uniqueness, complete registration, image count equality, and actual decoded image assertion. Product now supplies both original-PNG palette thumbnails. No skipped case, replaced ID, reduced viewport/mode matrix, lowered expectation, or asset-byte transformation.
